pictures.scene: Eastman Johnson, The Lord Is My Shepherd — the old man bent over the open book in the lamplight, a prayer of David, incline Your ear O LORD and answer me

pictures.scene: David Adolph Constant Artz, Bij grootmoeder — the bare cottage room with the child at the old woman's knee, for I am poor and needy, preserve my soul for I am godly

pictures.scene: Esaias van de Velde, A landscape with Christ and the Canaanite woman — the woman kneeling in the road to beg of Him, You are my God save Your servant who trusts in You, be merciful to me O Lord
pictures.name: pd_velde_cananese

pictures.scene: Julien Dupré, Retour de troupeau — the herd driven home across the field at the end of the day, for I call to You all day long, bring joy to Your servant
pictures.name: pd_dupre_troupeau

pictures.scene: Eugène Jansson, Sunrise over the Rooftops — the first light coming up over the sleeping town, for to You O Lord I lift up my soul, for You O Lord are kind and forgiving
pictures.name: pd_jansson_soluppgang

pictures.scene: Pierre Mignard, Christ and the Woman of Samaria — the stranger at the well given more than she came for, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You, hear my prayer O LORD
pictures.name: pd_mignard_samaritaanse

pictures.scene: Pieter Aertsen, De genezing van de lamme van Bethesda — the helpless man lifted up from his mat at the pool, and attend to my plea for mercy, in the day of my distress I call on You
pictures.name: pd_aertsen_bethesda

pictures.scene: Jacob Pynas, Paulus en Barnabas te Lystra door het volk als goden vereerd — the crowd bringing garlands to men who refuse them, because You answer me, O Lord there is none like You among the gods
pictures.name: pd_pynas_lystra

pictures.scene: Jan van Goyen, Landskapsmålning — the wide country lying under a rainbow after the rain, nor any works like Yours, all the nations You have made
pictures.name: pd_goyen_regenboog

pictures.scene: Pieter Bout, De aanbidding der herders — the shepherds kneeling in the straw before the child, will come and bow before You O Lord, and they will glorify Your name
pictures.name: pd_bout_herders

pictures.scene: Johan Edvard Bergh, Landscape with Waterfall from the Canton of Uri — the great fall pouring white out of the mountain wall, for You are great and perform wonders, You alone are God
pictures.name: pd_bergh_vattenfall

pictures.scene: Jan Brueghel the Elder, The Sermon on the Mount — the people seated on the hillside to be taught, teach me Your way O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth
pictures.name: pd_brueghel_bergrede

pictures.scene: Albert Neuhuys, Interieur met strijkende vrouw en naaiend kind — the mother ironing and the child sewing, each at one task, give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name
pictures.name: pd_neuhuys_interieur

pictures.scene: Pieter Symonsz. Potter, Musicerend gezelschap in een interieur — the players gathered with lute and viol over one song, I will praise You O Lord my God with all my heart, I will glorify Your name forever
pictures.name: pd_potter_musicerend

pictures.scene: Eduard von Gebhardt, The Raising of Lazarus — the dead man called back out of the tomb into the light, for great is Your loving devotion to me, You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol
pictures.name: pd_gebhardt_lazarus

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, The Capture of Christ — the torches and the armed men closing in on Him in the dark, the arrogant rise against me O God, a band of ruthless men seeks my life
pictures.name: pd_dyck_gevangenneming

pictures.scene: Meester van de Barmhartige Samaritaan, De barmhartige Samaritaan — the stranger lifting the beaten man onto his own beast, they have no regard for You, but You O Lord are a compassionate and gracious God
pictures.name: pd_samaritaan_meester

pictures.scene: Joseph Anton Koch, Landschaft mit Ruth und Boas — the gleaner left to gather freely in the rich man's field, slow to anger abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness, turn to me and have mercy
pictures.name: pd_koch_ruth

pictures.scene: Guercino, Rest on the Flight into Egypt — the mother holding her son safe on the road out of danger, grant Your strength to Your servant, save the son of Your maidservant
pictures.name: pd_guercino_vlucht

pictures.scene: Karl Millner, Partenkirchen in Bavaria at Sunrise — the valley taking the sun over the dark ridge, show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed
pictures.name: pd_millner_partenkirchen

pictures.scene: Anna Ancher, Harvesters — the reapers walking through the ripe corn in the summer light, for You O LORD have helped me and comforted me
pictures.name: pd_ancher_hostfolk

lines.text: A prayer of David.
Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me,
for I am poor and needy.
Preserve my soul, for I am godly.
You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
Be merciful to me, O Lord,
for I call to You all day long.
Bring joy to Your servant,
for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving,
rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
Hear my prayer, O LORD,
and attend to my plea for mercy.
In the day of my distress I call on You,
because You answer me.
O Lord, there is none like You among the gods,
nor any works like Yours.
All the nations You have made
will come and bow before You, O Lord,
and they will glorify Your name.
For You are great and perform wonders;
You alone are God.
Teach me Your way, O LORD,
that I may walk in Your truth.
Give me an undivided heart,
that I may fear Your name.
I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart;
I will glorify Your name forever.
For great is Your loving devotion to me;
You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
The arrogant rise against me, O God;
a band of ruthless men seeks my life;
they have no regard for You.
But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God,
slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
Turn to me and have mercy;
grant Your strength to Your servant;
save the son of Your maidservant.
Show me a sign of Your goodness,
that my enemies may see and be ashamed;
for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
